clients.sql:
SELECT pid,usename,state,xact_start IS NOT NULL AS transaction_open
      FROM pg_catalog.pg_stat_activity WHERE datname=current_database() AND pid<>pg_backend_pid()
      AND backend_type='client backend' ORDER BY pid

columns.sql:
SELECT n.nspname,c.relname,a.attname,pg_catalog.format_type(a.atttypid,a.atttypmod) AS type,
a.attnotnull,a.attidentity,a.attgenerated FROM pg_catalog.pg_attribute a
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class c ON c.oid=a.attrelid JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace
WHERE a.attnum>0 AND NOT a.attisdropped AND ((n.nspname NOT IN ('pg_catalog','information_schema')
AND n.nspname NOT LIKE 'pg_toast%') OR c.oid>=16384) ORDER BY n.nspname,c.relname,a.attnum

databases.sql:
SELECT datname,pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(datdba) AS owner,datistemplate,datallowconn
FROM pg_catalog.pg_database ORDER BY datname

default_acl.sql:
SELECT pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(defaclrole) AS owner,defaclnamespace,defaclobjtype,defaclacl::text
      FROM pg_catalog.pg_default_acl ORDER BY defaclrole,defaclnamespace,defaclobjtype

event_triggers.sql: SELECT evtname,evtenabled FROM pg_catalog.pg_event_trigger ORDER BY evtname

extensions.sql:
SELECT e.extname,e.extversion,n.nspname AS schema,pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(e.extowner) AS owner
      FROM pg_catalog.pg_extension e JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid=e.extnamespace ORDER BY e.extname

foreign_objects.sql:
SELECT 'wrapper' AS kind,fdwname AS name FROM pg_catalog.pg_foreign_data_wrapper
      UNION ALL SELECT 'server',srvname FROM pg_catalog.pg_foreign_server
      UNION ALL SELECT 'mapping',oid::text FROM pg_catalog.pg_user_mapping ORDER BY 1,2

functions.sql:
SELECT n.nspname,p.proname,pg_catalog.pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid) AS arguments,
      pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(p.proowner) AS owner,p.proacl::text AS acl,p.prosecdef,p.proconfig
      FROM pg_catalog.pg_proc p JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace
      WHERE n.nspname NOT IN ('pg_catalog','information_schema') OR (p.oid>=16384 AND NOT EXISTS
      (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_depend d WHERE d.classid='pg_proc'::regclass AND d.objid=p.oid AND d.deptype='e'))
      ORDER BY n.nspname,p.proname,arguments

hba_file.sql:
SELECT rule_number,type,database,user_name,address,netmask,auth_method,error IS NULL AS parse_ok
      FROM pg_catalog.pg_hba_file_rules ORDER BY rule_number

identity.sql:
SELECT current_database() AS database,current_user AS current_user,session_user AS session_user,
(SELECT oid::bigint FROM pg_catalog.pg_database WHERE datname=current_database()) AS database_oid,
(SELECT system_identifier::text FROM pg_catalog.pg_control_system()) AS system_identifier,
current_setting('server_version_num')::integer AS server_version_num,current_setting('server_version') AS server_version,
current_setting('transaction_read_only') AS transaction_read_only,pg_catalog.pg_is_in_recovery() AS recovery,
pg_catalog.host(pg_catalog.inet_server_addr()) AS server_ip,pg_catalog.inet_server_port() AS server_port,
current_setting('data_directory') AS data_directory,pg_catalog.pg_postmaster_start_time()::text AS postmaster_start,
current_setting('session_replication_role') AS replication,current_setting('row_security') AS row_security,
current_setting('search_path') AS search_path

locks.sql:
SELECT l.locktype,l.mode,l.granted,l.relation FROM pg_catalog.pg_locks l
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_stat_activity a ON a.pid=l.pid WHERE a.datname=current_database()
AND a.backend_type='client backend' AND l.pid<>pg_backend_pid() ORDER BY l.pid,l.locktype,l.mode

memberships.sql:
SELECT pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(roleid) AS role,pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(member) AS member,
      pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(grantor) AS grantor,admin_option,inherit_option,set_option
      FROM pg_catalog.pg_auth_members ORDER BY roleid,member

operators.sql:
SELECT n.nspname,o.oprname FROM pg_catalog.pg_operator o
      JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid=o.oprnamespace
      WHERE n.nspname<>'pg_catalog' OR o.oid>=16384 ORDER BY n.nspname,o.oprname

other_objects.sql:
SELECT 'collation' AS kind,n.nspname,c.collname AS name FROM pg_catalog.pg_collation c
      JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.collnamespace WHERE n.nspname<>'pg_catalog' OR c.oid>=16384
      UNION ALL SELECT 'conversion',n.nspname,c.conname FROM pg_catalog.pg_conversion c
      JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.connamespace WHERE n.nspname<>'pg_catalog' OR c.oid>=16384
      UNION ALL SELECT 'textsearch',n.nspname,c.cfgname FROM pg_catalog.pg_ts_config c
      JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.cfgnamespace WHERE n.nspname<>'pg_catalog' OR c.oid>=16384
      UNION ALL SELECT 'language','',lanname FROM pg_catalog.pg_language WHERE lanname NOT IN ('internal','c','sql','plpgsql')
      UNION ALL SELECT 'cast','',oid::text FROM pg_catalog.pg_cast WHERE oid>=16384
      UNION ALL SELECT 'access_method','',amname FROM pg_catalog.pg_am WHERE oid>=16384
      UNION ALL SELECT 'operator_class',n.nspname,c.opcname FROM pg_catalog.pg_opclass c JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.opcnamespace WHERE n.nspname<>'pg_catalog' OR c.oid>=16384
      UNION ALL SELECT 'operator_family',n.nspname,c.opfname FROM pg_catalog.pg_opfamily c JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.opfnamespace WHERE n.nspname<>'pg_catalog' OR c.oid>=16384
      UNION ALL SELECT 'textsearch_dictionary',n.nspname,c.dictname FROM pg_catalog.pg_ts_dict c JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.dictnamespace WHERE n.nspname<>'pg_catalog' OR c.oid>=16384
      UNION ALL SELECT 'textsearch_parser',n.nspname,c.prsname FROM pg_catalog.pg_ts_parser c JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.prsnamespace WHERE n.nspname<>'pg_catalog' OR c.oid>=16384
      UNION ALL SELECT 'textsearch_template',n.nspname,c.tmplname FROM pg_catalog.pg_ts_template c JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.tmplnamespace WHERE n.nspname<>'pg_catalog' OR c.oid>=16384
      UNION ALL SELECT 'transform','',oid::text FROM pg_catalog.pg_transform
      UNION ALL SELECT 'large_object','',oid::text FROM pg_catalog.pg_largeobject_metadata
      UNION ALL SELECT 'security_label','',objoid::text FROM pg_catalog.pg_seclabel ORDER BY 1,2,3

ownership_acl.sql:
SELECT oid::bigint AS oid,datname,pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(datdba) AS owner,
datacl IS NULL AS default_acl,datistemplate,datallowconn,datconnlimit,
pg_catalog.pg_encoding_to_char(encoding) AS encoding,datcollate,datctype,datlocprovider,datcollversion
FROM pg_catalog.pg_database WHERE datname=current_database()

plpgsql_functions.sql:
SELECT p.proname,pg_catalog.pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid) AS arguments,
pg_catalog.pg_get_function_result(p.oid) AS result,n.nspname,pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(p.proowner) AS owner,
l.lanname,p.prosecdef,p.proleakproof,p.proconfig,p.proacl IS NULL AS default_acl
FROM pg_catalog.pg_proc p JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_language l ON l.oid=p.prolang JOIN pg_catalog.pg_depend d
ON d.classid='pg_catalog.pg_proc'::regclass AND d.objid=p.oid AND d.deptype='e'
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_extension e ON e.oid=d.refobjid WHERE e.extname='plpgsql'
ORDER BY p.proname,arguments

privileges.sql:
SELECT pg_catalog.has_database_privilege(current_database(),'CONNECT') AS connect,
pg_catalog.has_database_privilege(current_database(),'CREATE') AS create_database_objects,
pg_catalog.has_database_privilege(current_database(),'TEMP') AS temporary,
pg_catalog.has_schema_privilege('public','USAGE') AS public_usage,
pg_catalog.has_schema_privilege('public','CREATE') AS public_create,
pg_catalog.has_table_privilege('pg_catalog.pg_authid','SELECT') AS role_read,
pg_catalog.has_function_privilege('pg_catalog.pg_control_system()','EXECUTE') AS control_read

relations.sql:
SELECT n.nspname,c.relname,c.relkind,c.relpersistence
      FROM pg_catalog.pg_class c JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace
      WHERE n.nspname NOT IN ('pg_catalog','information_schema') AND n.nspname NOT LIKE 'pg_toast%'
      OR (n.nspname='pg_catalog' AND c.oid>=16384) ORDER BY n.nspname,c.relname

replication.sql:
SELECT 'publication' AS kind,pubname AS name FROM pg_catalog.pg_publication
      UNION ALL SELECT 'subscription',subname FROM pg_catalog.pg_subscription WHERE subdbid=
      (SELECT oid FROM pg_catalog.pg_database WHERE datname=current_database()) ORDER BY 1,2

role_settings.sql:
SELECT setdatabase,setrole,setconfig IS NOT NULL AS has_settings
      FROM pg_catalog.pg_db_role_setting ORDER BY setdatabase,setrole

roles.sql:
SELECT r.oid,r.rolname,r.rolsuper,r.rolinherit,r.rolcreaterole,r.rolcreatedb,r.rolcanlogin,
      r.rolreplication,r.rolbypassrls,r.rolconnlimit,r.rolconfig IS NULL AS config_null,
      a.rolpassword IS NULL AS password_null,
      COALESCE(a.rolpassword LIKE 'SCRAM-SHA-256$%',false) AS password_scram
      FROM pg_catalog.pg_roles r JOIN pg_catalog.pg_authid a ON a.oid=r.oid ORDER BY r.rolname

rules.sql:
SELECT r.rulename FROM pg_catalog.pg_rewrite r JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class c ON c.oid=r.ev_class
      JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace
      WHERE n.nspname NOT IN ('pg_catalog','information_schema') ORDER BY r.rulename

schema_privileges.sql:
SELECT n.nspname,pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(n.nspowner) AS owner,
CASE WHEN a.grantee=0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(a.grantee) END AS grantee,
pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(a.grantor) AS grantor,
a.privilege_type,a.is_grantable FROM pg_catalog.pg_namespace n
CROSS JOIN LATERAL pg_catalog.aclexplode(COALESCE(n.nspacl,pg_catalog.acldefault('n',n.nspowner))) a
ORDER BY n.nspname,grantee,a.privilege_type

schemas.sql:
SELECT nspname, pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(nspowner) AS owner, nspacl::text AS acl
      FROM pg_catalog.pg_namespace ORDER BY nspname

settings.sql:
SELECT name,setting,source FROM pg_catalog.pg_settings WHERE name IN
('statement_timeout','lock_timeout','idle_in_transaction_session_timeout','default_transaction_read_only',
 'transaction_read_only','search_path','row_security','check_function_bodies','password_encryption','ssl',
 'listen_addresses','port','max_connections','shared_buffers','work_mem','stats_fetch_consistency') ORDER BY name

shared_dependencies.sql:
SELECT classid::regclass::text,objid,refclassid::regclass::text,refobjid,deptype
      FROM pg_catalog.pg_shdepend WHERE dbid=(SELECT oid FROM pg_catalog.pg_database WHERE datname=current_database())
      ORDER BY classid,objid,refclassid,refobjid,deptype

tablespaces.sql:
SELECT spcname,pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(spcowner) AS owner,spcacl IS NULL AS default_acl,
pg_catalog.pg_tablespace_location(oid) AS location FROM pg_catalog.pg_tablespace ORDER BY spcname

triggers.sql: SELECT tgname FROM pg_catalog.pg_trigger WHERE NOT tgisinternal ORDER BY tgname

types.sql:
SELECT n.nspname,t.typname,t.typtype FROM pg_catalog.pg_type t
      JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid=t.typnamespace
      WHERE n.nspname NOT IN ('pg_catalog','information_schema') AND n.nspname NOT LIKE 'pg_toast%'
      OR (n.nspname='pg_catalog' AND t.oid>=16384) ORDER BY n.nspname,t.typname
